description: A school examination marksheet issued by an Indian state or national board.

student_name.description: Full name of the candidate as printed on the marksheet.

roll_number.description: The candidate roll or registration number. Keep it as text so leading zeros and letters survive.

school_name.description: Name of the school or examination centre printed on the marksheet.

board_name.description: The examining board that issued the marksheet.

examination_name.description: The examination this marksheet reports, for example the annual class ten examination.

examination_year.description: The four digit year of the examination.

class_or_standard.description: The class or standard the candidate sat, as printed.

date_of_birth.description: The candidate date of birth, exactly as printed on the marksheet.

result_status.description: The overall result declared at the foot of the marksheet.

total_marks_obtained.description: Sum of marks obtained across all subjects, from the totals row.

total_marks_maximum.description: Maximum marks available across all subjects, from the totals row.

percentage.description: Overall percentage printed on the marksheet, if the board prints one.

division_or_grade.description: The division or overall grade awarded, as printed.

subjects.description: One entry per row of the subject-wise marks table.

items.description: A single subject row from the marks table.

subject_code.description: The subject code printed in the first column of the row.

subject_name.description: The subject name printed on the row.

theory_marks.description: Marks obtained in the theory paper for this subject.

practical_marks.description: Marks obtained in the practical or internal component for this subject.

total_marks.description: Total marks obtained in this subject, as printed at the end of the row.

maximum_marks.description: Maximum marks available in this subject.

grade.description: The letter grade for this subject, if the board prints grades.

subject_result.description: Whether the candidate passed this individual subject.
